title: Backend provenance and CUDA diagnostics
text: Normalization HVG calculations retain sparse Matrix storage. cuda_cell_pca() selects n_hvg rows materializes dense cell--feature matrix PCA. double copy selected matrix alone uses roughly 8 * cells * n_hvg bytes; centring, scaling, decomposition, CPU/GPU copies need additional working memory. Lower n_hvg lowering n_components dense input memory constraint, selected matrix allocated decomposition. Exact kNN remains quadratic time, retain complete cell--cell distance matrix. resident double distance block approximately 8 * min(batch_size, cells) * cells bytes, returned distances use 8 * cells * k bytes plus integer index matrix. Lower batch_size reduce peak memory; change neighbours.

title: cudacellr 0.3.0
text: Added cudacell_sce() native, non-destructive SingleCellExperiment workflow. Normalized expression, PCA, HVG statistics, kNN relationships, compute provenance written corresponding assay, reduced dimension, rowData, colPair, metadata locations. Existing assays, row column metadata, reduced dimensions, alternative experiments, pairings, canonical size factors, labels, user metadata preserved. Output collisions fail computation unless explicitly replaced overwrite = TRUE. Delayed assays never materialized silently. realize = TRUE required opt -memory sparse realization. cuda_provenance() now reads ordered computation record directly SingleCellExperiment produced cudacell_sce(). cuda_cell_pca() cudacell_workflow() now expose normalization scale_factor, log1p, min_mean controls; complete workflow also exposes PCA scaling scale..

title: cudacellr 0.2.0
text: Normalization, HVG selection, PCA, kNN now compose one ordered cudaverse-stage/1 provenance record, including upstream sparse materialization. cudacell_workflow() reports aggregate CPU/CUDA/hybrid compute device, print method longer implies PCA device represents complete workflow. Strict CUDA requests validated CPU preprocessing begins, avoiding expensive work unavailable-device error. Re-exported cuda_provenance() common inspector single-cell results.

title: cudacellr 0.1.2
text: Feature cell identifiers now survive normalization, HVG selection, PCA, kNN, complete workflow. HVG results retain original feature indices, including feature names duplicated. Added concise print() method workflow results strict validation log1p flag.

title: cudacellr 0.1.1
text: cuda_cell_neighbors() cudacell_workflow() now expose batch_size, using bounded-memory exact kNN implementation cudalearnr. cudacell_workflow() now reuses normalized matrix variable-feature result PCA instead performing preprocessing stages twice.
